hazards: Fire and thermal-runaway risk from punctured or crushed lithium-ion batteries
Lead, arsenic, cadmium, and brominated flame retardants in screens and internal boards
safe_handling: Back up data and perform a factory reset
Power off the device completely and remove SIM/SD cards
Store flat in a cool, dry place away from sharp or metallic objects
unsafe_actions: Do not pry out glued-in batteries using sharp metal tools
Do not bend, crush, or puncture the phone
what_to_do_if_damaged: Stop using and charging the phone. If its battery is swollen, hot, hissing, smoking, or leaking, do not touch or move it. Keep people away, avoid fumes, and contact a qualified technician or emergency services. For broken glass without battery damage, avoid direct contact and arrange safe collection.
disposal_route: Return through brand take-back/exchange programs, certified refurbishers (if functional), or a CPCB-registered e-waste recycler.
recoverable_materials: High-purity gold, silver, palladium, and copper (circuitry)
environmental_impact: Informal acid-leaching and open burning release toxic heavy metals and poisonous fumes, while landfilling wastes scarce precious and rare-earth metals.
